Vision Government Solutions

POMFRET,CT

Welcome

Welcome to the Town of Pomfret, CT’s online assessment
database.

The Pomfret website is scheduled to update on a monthly basis with the most recent data.

The associated field cards have been updated as of 1/06/2025. These are a snapshot in time and are not scheduled for update at this time.

Do not apply the current mill rate to your new assessment as
the mill rate will change annually. July 2025
tax bills will be based a mill rate of 21.03 for Town and 0.087 for Fire.

If you wish to appeal your assessment after the informal
hearing process is complete, you must file a written appeal to the Pomfret
Board of Assessment Appeals. The appeal application will be found in the
Assessor’s Office, on the Assessor’s page of the Town’s website at www.pomfretct.gov [https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=http-3A__www.pomfretct.gov&d=DwMFAg&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=LGIZFrXRrWBbRx5NNL3E1eWC-FmYHCsawUol-5210u0&m=4pDJK_H5bNBpqI-0TOOhsjIMKVeFfgcQsvaG1qpjz_zYGyMCgssRCIzfgm_h0Mg0&s=rQP4g9AdcazMazYHGv40bd1ovqTdea8ffDyyRA6jFC8&e=] or
by request at assessor@pomfretct.gov [mailto:assessor@pomfretct.gov] .
The appeal application will be made available after January 15, 2027 and must
be received on or before February 20, 2027.

You may be prompted to install Silverlight (a free product from Microsoft) after you enter. Follow all the prompts to run the plug-in installer. In some cases, you may need to refresh or restart your browser. If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
